# Mihomo API fixtures

Synthetic minimal responses use the field shapes in
[Mihomo v1.19.0 routes](https://github.com/MetaCubeX/mihomo/tree/v1.19.0/hub/route).
They test parsing and policy behavior, not a live deployment of that version.
The secret marker is intentionally fictitious and must never reach observations.
Add a version directory, provenance note and regression when contributing a new
shape. Do not add real subscription URLs, credentials or full proxy parameters.
